private_all_local_axiom_audit.mode: Every actual kernel constName from each module public/server/private .olean part is checked with native Lean.CollectAxioms under a separate import all of that module; codegen extraConstNames are excluded.

scope_limitations: The theorem classifies actual valid connected finite cyclic polygonal quotients into sphere, orientable or nonorientable normal forms, with possible boundary.

The original Fuchsian side-word quotient adapter, exclusion of boundary and nonorientable cases, relation with the existing actual genus model, and the actual Euler/area identity are separate project proofs.
No informal upstream comment is used as a proof; these prerequisites alone do not establish the geometric adapters or area identities.
existing_api_preservation: All existing public modules, including the already-mapped SchoenfliesIsBridge Graph interface, remain unchanged.

private_archon_mcp.raw_results: Stored privately per module; informational upstream tactic suggestions retained without altering mathematical statements.

public_verification.raw_archon_diagnostics: Retained privately per source, including all six informational messages.

complete_kernel_audit_scope.owner_scope_validation: The independent raw scan also contained nine unchanged reused modules (2065 kernel declarations); these are excluded from the 106 newly imported module owners. All 14148 declarations of the new owner set are audited in both environments, with exact per-module kernel-table coverage.

namespace_compatibility.mathematical_change: None; only unique names for newly imported duplicate helpers and their internal references.
